Same product and unit. The replacement is dated later, at least %2$s from today (your replacement days). The kit batch is dated 1 day to %1$s from today (your near-date days). Both have a confirmed full date: Best by, Use by, or Expires. Medicine, documents, and subscriptions are never swapped.
Replacement days are a planning choice, not a safety guarantee.

A notification that pops up with a sound, at most once a day, when household items need review. It names up to two of them, but never medicine.
Open DueWise to see the review list.
Shows how many of your own household items need review, without naming them. Tap it to open DueWise.
These are planning choices, not safety guarantees.
Saved now, used once the rules are finished.
Dates within this many days count as near. 1\u00A0to 365, default 30.
A replacement\'s date must be at least this far away. Up to 3650, default 180.
Enter more than the near-date days (%1$d).
Daily, when dates are near or passed. Never names medicine.
Soonest dates first, for example “Canned beans, Granola bars, and 3 others”. Medicine shows only as “medicine”.
